components.name: Action
components.description: The one primary step on a view: outlined rectangle, serif label left, arrow right; fills to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-action { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); padding: 1.5rem 2rem; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action__arrow { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6em; line-height: 1; transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action:hover { background: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); color: var(--paper, oklch(90.5% 0.008 108)); } .ds-action:hover .ds-action__arrow { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, oklch(48% 0.2 300)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Document nav
components.description: Tracked uppercase links with the lime spark square at the end.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 3px; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); } .ds-spark { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); color: var(--lime, oklch(88% 0.21 122)); border-bottom: 0 !important; }

components.name: Status
components.description: Dot plus tracked label. Leaf for settled, muted for queued, amber-deep for confirming.
components.html: Settled Queued Confirming
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5em; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-right: 1rem; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: .5em; height: .5em; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status--settled { color: var(--leaf, oklch(58% 0.15 148)); } .ds-status--queued { color: var(--ink-2, oklch(41% 0.012 290)); } .ds-status--confirming { color: var(--amber-deep, oklch(56% 0.16 48)); }

components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, oklch(17% 0.012 290)); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem minmax(0,1fr) auto 7.5rem; gap: 1rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(79% 0.012 108)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(79% 0.012 108)); } .ds-row__t { color: var(--ink-2, oklch(41% 0.012 290)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row__who small { display: block; color: var(--ink-2, oklch(41% 0.012 290)); font-size: .9rem; } .ds-row__amt { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-row .ds-status { justify-self: end; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Two surfaces share every screen. On the left is the field: a dusty violet ground where three large blurred masses of violet, magenta and coral drift slowly and never stop. It is where the agent lives and where Earthy, an amber character with a face and two hands, stands and speaks. On the right is the ledger: a pale warm-gray document in the Notion and Obsidian register, structured only by hairlines and whitespace, where every claim is a line item with a time, an amount and a status. The split is the argument. Warmth and life on one side, receipts on the other.

The ledger is deliberately plain so that the few colored things carry meaning: lime for the brand mark and the live state, leaf green for money that has settled, amber for Earthy, violet for links. Type is high-contrast serif for everything that must feel declared (headings, every large number) and a quiet grotesk for everything that must simply be read. Primary actions are large outlined rectangles with a serif label on the left and an arrow on the right, which fill to ink on hover. Nothing casts a shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Split shell: dark living field left (40%), pale document right, stacked on phones.
Hairline structure only. No cards, no shadows, no rounded containers.
High-contrast serif for headings and all large figures; tracked uppercase labels for metadata.
Four accents with one job each: lime (brand and live), leaf (settled money), amber (Earthy), violet (links).
Earthy is articulated: body breath, blink, a morphing mouth, brows, and two hands with named gestures.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each accent has exactly one meaning. Leaf is never decorative; lime never marks money; amber never leaves Earthy.

rules.name: The Recorded Surface Rule
rules.body: Anything the agent recorded is shown on the field's dark surface, even inside the document. The visitor learns that dark means "captured by the agent."

rules.name: The Serif Number Rule
rules.body: Any number large enough to be read from across the room is set in the serif. Small numbers stay in the body face; hashes stay in mono.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No label sits above a heading. Labels sit above stats, beside statuses, and in nav, never as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Flat Document Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. If something needs to feel raised, it changes color (Field Raised on Paper), never shadow.

dos: Do keep the field dark and moving and the document pale and still; the contrast is the design.
Do set every large number in Instrument Serif and every hash in Martian Mono.
Do show anything the agent recorded on the Field Raised surface, even inside the document.
Do use the large outlined action for the one primary step on a view, and Lime only for the buy action.
Do label sample data as sample data wherever a visitor could mistake it for live figures.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded containers, or cards. Structure is hairlines and space.
Don't place a label or step number above a heading.
Don't use Leaf for anything other than confirmed money, or Lime for anything other than the brand mark, live state and the buy action.
Don't let Earthy's amber appear on UI elements; it belongs to the character.
Don't animate layout properties; motion is transform and opacity, and the field's masses are transform-only.
